comment: Words the 1.1 listing must not use: each names a feature the app does not have (ADR 0033, issue 530). A text is checked in the language of its locale; the notes for App Review are English. 'allowedIn' lists the fields where the word may still appear, because What's New says in one line that the 1.0 AI draft is gone. 'pendingLocales' is a baseline that may only shrink: a locale still written for 1.0 stays on it until its texts are rewritten, and the checker refuses a locale on it whose texts pass ('notes' is the notes for App Review).
